summary: 8 film announcements, 12 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Deep End
film.talent: Shawn Levy (21 Laps), Alex Cooper (Unwell Productions)
film.announcement: Netflix lands Ali Hazelwood's hot new adult romance novel for a feature film adaptation with Shawn Levy's 21 Laps and Alex Cooper's Unwell Productions producing.

film.title: Thud
film.talent: Sarah Michelle Gellar, Rudy Pankow, Brandon Scott, Vincent Rodriguez III
film.announcement: Grim reaper-devil romance film starring Sarah Michelle Gellar and Rudy Pankow rounds out cast with six final additions.

film.title: Exit to the Guillotine
film.announcement: Psychological thriller starring Peyton List and Gustaf Skarsgård wraps filming.

film.title: Diya
film.announcement: Animated Bollywood-focused musical in development at Paramount with producers Jonathan Goldstein and John Francis Daley.

film.title: Wildwood
film.announcement: Laika's Portland-set stop-motion adventure film gets poster reveal teasing project details.

film.title: The Bonfire of the Vanities
film.announcement: Series adaptation of Tom Wolfe novel from David E. Kelley and Matt Reeves is not moving forward at Apple TV and will be shopped to other outlets.

film.title: Late Fame
film.announcement: Willem Dafoe discusses his role as a poet in the film and his collaborations with directors Robert Eggers and Yorgos Lanthimos.

film.title: The Shards
film.announcement: Ryan Murphy's adaptation of Bret Easton Ellis' bestseller is available to watch on FX.

tv.title: Gilmore Girls Documentary
tv.announcement: Documentary about the beloved series is in development at HBO Max featuring Lauren Graham and never-before-seen footage.

tv.title: The Five Star Weekend
tv.announcement: Peacock renews the adaptation for season 2 after it becomes the streamer's most-watched scripted series ever with 2.1 billion minutes viewed.

tv.title: I Love LA
tv.talent: Taron Egerton, Jamie Chung, Milan Carter
tv.announcement: Season 2 adds Taron Egerton, Jamie Chung, Milan Carter and more in guest star roles.

tv.title: Trauma
tv.announcement: Richard Madden to star in medical hostage thriller series at Paramount+ and Prime Video UK.

tv.title: The Secret of Secrets
tv.talent: Cherry Jones, Corey Stoll, Rob Delaney, Abbey Lee
tv.announcement: Cherry Jones, Corey Stoll, Rob Delaney and Abbey Lee join Netflix's Dan Brown novel TV adaptation.

tv.title: Disinherited
tv.announcement: Avi Nash joins FX drama series.

tv.title: The Voice: Celebrity
tv.announcement: Keke Palmer to host The Voice: Celebrity spinoff in 2027 as Carson Daly confirms he is not leaving The Voice.

tv.title: Carnival of the Animals
tv.announcement: PBS Kids and conductor Gustavo Dudamel partner on 2D animated special.

tv.title: The Challenge: Cutthroat II
tv.announcement: Cast announced for season 42 of the reality competition series.

tv.title: The Shards
tv.announcement: Ryan Murphy's adaptation of Bret Easton Ellis' bestseller series now available.

tv.title: Wizards Beyond Waverly Place
tv.announcement: David Henrie discusses the emotional finale ending and expresses hopes for a movie sequel.
